trap.label: remember + -ing
trap.wrong: I remembered to see the old bridge as a child.
trap.right: I remembered seeing the old bridge as a child.
trap.why: O português usa “lembrar de ver” nos dois casos. Em inglês, o sentido muda: lembrança do passado = -ing; tarefa a cumprir = to + base.

mcq.why: Nevertheless começa nova frase, com vírgula depois.

mcq.q: Remember ___ milk on the way home!
The man ___ lives next door is a chef.
mcq.why: Pronome relativo para pessoa: who; sem pronome extra.

fix.wrong: The man who he lives here is kind.
fix.right: The man who lives here is kind.
fix.why: Não repita o sujeito depois do relativo.

fix.right: She is likely to finish early.

rewrite.prompt: Una com who: “I met a woman. She teaches law.”
rewrite.answer: I met a woman who teaches law.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com unlikely: “He will probably not agree.”
Reescreva com remember + -ing: “I recall that I met him.”
